environment.description: Ktor 2.3.4 microservice running on JDK 17 (Corretto) in a standard Docker container (debian:bookworm-slim base). Container runs as non-root user 'app' (uid 1000). The service processes XML invoices from authenticated internal clients. No XML parser hardening flags are set. Container has access to /etc/passwd, /proc/self/environ, and mounted secrets at /run/secrets/db-credentials.
